data.title: Ethereum price jumps 5% to $1,966, nearing key ... | Pluang
data.description: Ethereum's price surged 5% to $1,966 on July 27, driven by increased spot demand, short liquidations, and reduced available supply as staking rates hit a record 34%. Trading volume more than doubled, supporting the rally toward the critical $2,000 resistance level. Technical indicators show strong momentum but warn of possible short-term pullbacks near this barrier. Analysts suggest that if Ethereum can hold above $2,000, it may target higher levels between $2,350 and $2,500, while failure to sustain this level could lead to consolidation around $1,930 or lower support zones.
